name: Tarantula

features.claim: A tarantula's body has two main parts: the front part (prosoma) and the abdomen (opisthosoma).
features.quote: a tarantula's body comprises two main parts, the prosoma (or cephalothorax) and the opisthosoma (or abdomen)

features.claim: The two body parts are joined by a narrow waist-like piece called the pedicel.
features.quote: The prosoma and opisthosoma are connected by the pedicel, or pregenital somite.

features.claim: A tarantula has eight legs, two chelicerae with fangs, and pedipalps, all attached to the front body part.
features.quote: The eight legs, the two chelicerae with their fangs, and the pedipalps are attached to the prosoma.
Each leg has seven segments, which from the prosoma out are: coxa, trochanter, femur, patella, tibia, tarsus and pretarsus, and claw.
Tarantula fangs face downward, as opposed to those of true spiders, which face each other, allowing them to make pincerlike motions.

features.claim: The chelicerae sit just below the eyes and in front of the mouth.
features.quote: The chelicerae are two double-segmented appendages located just below the eyes and directly forward of the mouth.

features.claim: The eyes are small and usually set in two rows of four.
features.quote: They are small and are usually set in two rows of four.

features.claim: The spinnerets are at the end of the abdomen.
features.quote: Tarantulas, like almost all other spiders, have their primary spinnerets at the end of the opisthosoma.

features.claim: Tarantulas have two or four spinnerets.
features.quote: tarantula species have two or four spinnerets

features.claim: The body is covered in bristles called setae.
features.quote: A tarantula perceives its surroundings primarily via sensory organs called setae (bristles or spines, sometimes referred to as hairs).

features.claim: Many tarantulas have a dense covering of irritating bristles called urticating hairs on the abdomen.
features.quote: some tarantulas also have a dense covering of irritating bristles called urticating hairs, on the opisthosoma, that they sometimes use as protection against enemies

features.claim: Tarantulas are large and often hairy spiders.
features.quote: Tarantulas are a group of large and often hairy spiders of the family Theraphosidae.

second_reading.claim: The sources do not agree on how many species of tarantula there are.
second_reading.quote: More than a thousand species have been identified, within almost 200 genera.
